Content: Employee Benefits Eligible employees may receive benefits according to company policy. Benefits can include health insurance, retirement benefits, leave benefits and other employee programs. Eligibility may depend on employment type and applicable company rules. Employees should contact HR for questions regarding individual benefit eligibility.

Employee Leave Policy Employees are eligible for annual leave according to their employment category and company policy. Employees should submit planned leave requests through the internal leave management system. Leave requests should normally be submitted in advance and require manager approval. Emergency leave should be communicated to the manager as soon as possible. Employees should check the HR portal for their individual leave balance.

Remote Work Policy Employees may work remotely when their role and project requirements allow remote work. Remote work arrangements require manager approval. Employees working remotely must maintain normal working hours and remain available through approved communication channels. Company information must only be accessed using approved company systems and secure connections. Employees are responsible for protecting company information while working remotely.

Information Security Policy Employees must protect company systems and information. Passwords must not be shared with other employees. Employees should use multi-factor authentication where required. Confidential company information must not be shared with unauthorized persons. Security incidents must be reported to the appropriate security or IT team. Employees must lock their computer when leaving their workstation.

Business Travel Policy Business travel must be approved before travel arrangements are made. Employees should use the company's approved travel booking process. Reasonable business travel expenses may be reimbursed according to company policy. Employees must retain receipts for eligible expenses. International travel may require additional approval depending on the destination and purpose of travel.
